job_description:
ABS Group is a global professional services company with 87 offices in 33 countries. Our Global Government division headquartered in Arlington VA deploys cutting-edge technical expertise for federal agencies such as the Department of Homeland Security Department of Transportation and Department of Interior. At ABS Group you can transform the way agencies quantify analyze and ultimately manage risk.

We are seeking a Junior Python Developer to help conceptualize and develop ground-breaking solutions for our clients.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated history of Developing software applications (can be during an internship or personal projects) Creative thinking and problem-solving Meeting deadlines in fast-paced goal-oriented environment Collaborating effectively within a team to achieve a goal/objective

Required Experience with object-oriented programming in Python

Desired UI/UX experience Experience with database systems such as SQL and Oracle Blazor and Telerik experience Azure experience Experience with statistical modeling Agile development experience QT Framework and/or .NET framework experience

Education & Experience Requirements 0-3 years of relevant professional experience Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field (e.g. Computer Science Engineering Applied Mathematics Data Analytics Statistics etc.) or equivalent experience Must be able to obtain and maintain Secret
